subjective_feedback: The externally observable state supports only one firm operational conclusion: Maude was not installed or ready. The run cannot support a clean judgment about the operator's stopping decision, authority comprehension, command quality, or error handling because prohibited source inspection triggered wholesale transcript withholding. Separately, the documentation is poorly suited to this offline, non-owner role because it assumes dependency availability and folds sibling Governor installation into the Quick Start.
